_readme: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, per provider and model. Used by pipeline/token_tracker.py. A null price means 'not confirmed yet': any row with tokens in that class is recorded as UNPRICED (cost_usd = null), never guessed. Fill in a price, then re-run `python -m pipeline.token_report <output> --reprice` to back-fill old rows. cache_write = 5-minute prompt-cache write (1.25x input on Anthropic). input = uncached input tokens.
